notes.title: Live-streaming Wayward Strand for the Steam Game Festival!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35872257/89f6ae63c583b9ea85297d98772273ab89b5a9bd.png[/img]


Hey there!

We're really excited to have been invited to be a part of the Steam Game Festival - taking place on [b]June 16th to 22nd[/b] - and to get to show you the game we've been spending the past few years putting together.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35872257/6a2c5e81e61d0d89e0aa3265bf4a2ad65b184a5c.png[/img]


Wayward Strand is our heartfelt interactive narrative game, with a curious real-time twist. In it, you play as Casey, a teenage girl, and a budding journalist, who explores an airborne hospital, and gets to know the patients and staff on board.

Part of the reason making Wayward Strand has taken so long is that it has quite an experimental structure, inspired by immersive theatre - each character in the game has their own storyline which plays out simultaneously, on a shared timeline with the player - so as you explore the world of Wayward Strand over the course of three in-game days, everything moves and lives around you.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35872257/a7fee6f131daf5694247a916ba95ecf83c7ee6cf.png[/img]


The characters that you spend time with in Wayward Strand are the heart of our story - they're funny, quiet, sarcastic, complex, lovely, lonely, and sometimes a bit rude. Wayward Strand is set in the geriatric ward of the airborne hospital, and the entire space is filled out with characters, from the wonderful and varied elderly patients, to the staff that look after them and who keep the place running.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35872257/a2b6d0803c5d9bef6744b7c11c2c923bba6bb9c7.png[/img]


We're going to be doing a special, live developer play-through of Wayward Strand for the Steam Game Festival - [b]set a reminder[/b] for this event, and you'll be notified when we go live!

During the live-stream we'll be introducing you to some of these characters and their stories (but we'll do our best to keep it spoiler-light), as well as showing you some of the nooks and crannies of this experimental, beautiful experience we've put together. 

The process of creating Wayward Strand has been a wonderful journey, and we're chuffed to get to share more about it with you all. If you have any questions, we'll be monitoring the stream chat on the day, but also feel free to get in any questions beforehand on any of the channels we're on - in the replies to this post, or on [url=https://twitter.com/waywardstrand]Twitter[/url], [url=https://facebook.com/waywardstrand]Facebook[/url] or in our [url=https://discord.gg/EKuH9br]Discord[/url] (come say hi!).

We are making our most recent playable demo downloadable for #LudoNarraCon 2020, which means you can play it at home! When we’ve shown it at real-life events, there are some common questions that we are asked, so we decided it’s probably convenient to have a lil’ post with some of our most Frequently Asked Questions... Answered.

(Note: We’re putting this up a few hours before the demo goes live - you'll be able to access it for about a week, starting from [b]Friday April 24th, at 10:00 AM PT[/b].)

Here we go!

[h1]Is the game going to be fully voiced?[/h1]
Yes! The beauty of a demo is that we’re allowed to show our game when it’s still a work-in-progress. Only some lines in the current playable demo are voiced, but our current plan is that all characters will be fully voiced in the final game.

Some of the other things we’ll be doing before launch are more art passes to increase the beauty (if it is possible, amirite?), a UI design pass, and there are still a few more characters who aren’t in this demo! We have some work left to do on Wayward Strand, but we hope this demo gives you an idea of how it all is going to come together. We’re very proud of it :)

[h1]When is the game coming out?[/h1]
This is a hard question to answer. We want to bring you Wayward Strand as soon as we can of course. You’ll probably see lots of indies answering this question with a little bit of hesitation - we don’t want to let you down, or give the wrong date, but as we’ve seen this year sometimes stuff comes up, gets delayed etc. Our hope is to have Wayward Strand ready for you within a year, but a lot of it depends on boring things like funding and production timelines and etc.!

[h1]What platforms will Wayward Strand be available on?[/h1]
At the moment, we can only confirm Steam, however since beginning development, our back end has been set up to port the game to consoles, and mobile too. This question depends quite a bit on what our funding situation ends up being - just part of what being an indie dev is these days!

[h1]Is the game multiplayer?[/h1]
Wayward Strand is fully single-player - with no in app purchases or skins and no loot boxes!

While it’s intended as a single-player experience, it is a lovely game to play with someone else! Either playing it together with someone (how nice!), or each of you playing it at the same time, or during the same week as some friends can enrich your experience quite a lot. 

With so much ground to cover and so many characters to meet, it’s gonna take a lot of dedication to uncover all of the events and conversations in Wayward Strand yourself. Playing at the same time as a friend allows you to compare your experiences, and tip each other off to interesting, funny or curious things that they might have missed, and you might even have the knowledge to answer some questions they haven’t resolved.

We hope a lot of the themes in Wayward Strand will spark conversations, too, so playing with friends or family is a great idea. Likewise, [url=https://discord.gg/cqKnRBs]we have a Discord[/url] where you’re totally encouraged to nerd out about Wayward Strand - just use the spoiler tag!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35872257/20d94a410375ddc3df6a1e22e8154b0425922c1c.png[/img]

[h1]What do you DO in Wayward Strand?[/h1]
There’s no wrong way to play Wayward Strand. Because all of our characters will be moving around the ship and following their own schedules, you’re not meant to be able to catch every conversation or event that happens - just like you wouldn’t be able to in the real world! 

You can stick to a particular character like glue if you want to, or float around and talk to everyone. You can even eavesdrop on conversations if that’s more your style. During conversations you’ll have opportunities to answer questions, as well as opportunities to ask them, or just to chat! 

There are questions, and conversations which may give you some more leads to follow on particular curious things you come across, learn or overhear. You can also just enjoy a character’s company Wayward Strand is about wandering through this world and these characters’ stories. While you can’t win or lose Wayward Strand, your actions are important to the other characters (whether you know it or not!)

We’re designing Wayward Strand to be a pretty chilled out experience to play. We’ve had lots of people exasperatedly tell us that they’re going to try to learn EVERYTHING on board - and, good luck to them! Play it a dozen times! But, the game is designed to be a pleasant and lovely experience if you just play it through once and follow your nose, too. Kinda like curling up with a good book in your favourite chair. Toasty.


[h1]Who is making the game?[/h1]
We are Ghost Pattern! We are a small studio (soon to be a small co-op!) based in Melbourne, Australia. There are currently six people on our core team, and we also work with a lot of other collaborators in Melbourne on things like art and consultation. There’s a full list of the credits so far in the demo, definitely check it out!

If you’d like to follow us on Twitter, we’re on there as [url=https://twitter.com/WaywardStrand]@WaywardStrand[/url], and below is a list of some of our individual accounts:

[list]
[*] [url=https://twitter.com/MaizeWallin]@MaizeWallin[/url] - Maize Wallin
[*] [url=https://twitter.com/RussellDilley]@RussellDilley[/url] - Russell Dilley
[*] [url=https://twitter.com/GhostTownGoldie]@GhostTownGoldie[/url] - Marigold Bartlett
[*] [url=https://twitter.com/jason_bakker]@jason_bakker[/url] - Jason Bakker
[*] [url=https://twitter.com/Kalonica_]@Kalonica_[/url] - Kalonica Quigley
[*] [url=https://twitter.com/aspenforster]@aspenforster[/url] - Aspen Forster
[/list]

And a special mention to Georgia Symons ([url=https://twitter.com/biscuitpolicy]@biscuitpolicy[/url]) - she’s an amazing writer that has contributed a ton of writing to Wayward Strand, as well as dramaturgy and voice-over direction!

[h1]How can I stay in touch?[/h1]
Definitely [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1080450/Wayward_Strand/]give us a wishlist here[/url] and subscribe, we’re going to aim to do some fairly regular Steam Blogs going ahead. None of us are social media experts, we’re game developers, but we will do our best!

We do tweet fairly regularly too - either about our own game or about other cool indie projects we have our eye on, so that’s an interesting place to sign up. Likewise, we have a [url=https://facebook.com/waywardstrand]Facebook page[/url] and have launched a Discord too - [url=https://discord.gg/cqKnRBs]come and hang out![/url] Furthermore, you can sign up for our newsletter at waywardstrand.com

And if you have more in-depth questions or queries, we’re happy to receive them at [url=mailto:hello@waywardstrand.com]hello@waywardstrand.com[/url].

Hope you enjoy the demo!

notes.title: Wayward Strand - Demo and Stream @ #LudoNarraCon!
notes.content:
Hey there!

We’ve had our Steam page up for a little while, but we’re going to get a lot more active on here for the next little bit - we’re part of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/newshub/group/33025617/view/1827838782002270091]#LudoNarraCon[/url], a wonderful free online event all about narrative games that’s happening right here on Steam, starting in only a few more hours!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1080450/Wayward_Strand

We’re going to have a demo, playable online for the very first time, that you’ll be able to access right from our store page! (An FAQ to go along with it will be appearing shortly.) It’ll be available from [b]Friday 10:00 AM PT[/b], which is [b]Saturday 4:00 AM[/b] here in Melbourne, until the morning of the 1st of May!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35872257/79845da34b6431b61300b54b4797a3e424988e86.png[/img]
We’ve also got a looping stream throughout the entire event that has heaps of exciting interviews and discussion on there, including:
[list]
[*] An interview with some of the team, conducted by a professional real life games journalist! (Casey would be so proud of us.)
[*] Some character deep dives, exploring certain characters’ histories and design process (with minimal spoilers).
[*] An exploration of the tech and design behind our experimental simultaneous story structure.
[*] A consultation session with a 1970s nurse.
[/list]

We’re also hoping to go live at a couple of points throughout LNC, where we’ll be able to answer questions about the demo and all the stuff on our other streams! We’re currently planning to do these at [b]Friday 7:00 PM PT[/b] ([b]Saturday 12:00 PM AEST[/b]), and then again at [b]Saturday 9:00 PM PT[/b] ([b]Sunday 2:00 PM AEST[/b]). These will be pretty open and free-wheeling - we’re just keen to connect with you, answers questions and chat!

We’re really looking forward to LudoNarraCon - we hope you enjoy it, and if you’ve got friends on Steam that might be interested, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1080450/Wayward_Strand/]send them a link[/url]! There are gonna be heaps of demos, sales, panels, streams… it’s gonna be a super exciting weekend, and we’ll see you there!!
